question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the 5 R's needed to be followed for sustainable development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Regeneration**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Regeneration** is NOT a part of the **5 R's** needed to be followed for sustainable development.
 
• The 5 R's stand for **Refuse**, **Reduce**, **Reuse**, **Repurpose**, and **Recycle**.
 
• Each of these practices helps in minimizing waste and promoting a more sustainable lifestyle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Refuse**: Avoid using or buying products that produce waste.
 
• **Reduce**: Minimize the amount of waste you produce.
 
• **Reuse**: Use items more than once before discarding them.
 
• **Repurpose**: Find new uses for items that would otherwise be thrown away.
 
• **Recycle**: Process items to make them into new products.
 
• These principles are crucial for reducing the environmental impact and conserving natural resources.
